completed_part: Incremental XML/BSL updates and branch roundtrip; revalidate changed root/config inputs and metadata context; reject old model replies and delayed edits.

checks.native_installed: Exact results are stored in the external VSIX receipt.

vsix.checksum_note: Final hash and installed-host results are stored beside the archive to avoid a self-referential checksum.

behavior.metadata_model: Existing ProjectWatcher observations, BSL buffer changes and selected-context metadata notifications invalidate model generations.
behavior.ordinary_xml_bsl: Published upstream watcher owns incremental indexing. A configStatus check does not prepare/restart a current config.
behavior.config_inputs: Root descriptors come from the existing backend DTO; exact managed-config watcher and immediate manifest invalidation. Stop owned LSP and release lease before regeneration.
behavior.same_config: Keep PID and restore existing/latest buffered diagnostics for unchanged document instances/versions, even when upstream emits no replacement push.
behavior.late_results: General outgoing-request middleware covers all client requests. Delayed quick fixes retain their original model generation.
behavior.manual_config: A managed-body conflict stops only the owned LSP and preserves the edited file.
behavior.lifecycle: Session owns config watcher; pending checks use the current abort scope and cannot resume a discarded/conflicting session.

evidence_scope.unit: Production controller, DTO and edit guard; mocked process/protocol/editor boundaries. Coalescing, old replies, diagnostics, stale config, user conflict and late conflict check.
evidence_scope.native_refresh: Real project, published 0.3.2 and native providers; small owned Designer XML fixture and two owned Git branches. Support policy explicitly disabled for this refresh profile.
evidence_scope.native_xml: Changing CommonModule Global false/true changes actual unqualified BSL definition resolution; PID remains unchanged.
evidence_scope.native_branch: Switch A to B and back changes open clean BSL buffers and actual definition targets; PID remains unchanged.
evidence_scope.native_rapid: 30 rapid buffer replacements between broken/repaired text end with zero ParseError diagnostics and a correct definition. Not a proof about every possible unversioned push race.
evidence_scope.native_inputs: Changed root descriptor creates new fingerprint/LSP while Metadata PID remains. Manifest change replaces both services. Same config bytes preserve PID; manual config bytes survive conflict. Same-byte config write preserves existing ParseError diagnostics; a later repair clears them.
